guide.title: 参与前安全检查
guide.description: 核对官方域名后再操作。请使用专用的独立空投钱包，任何时候都不要输入助记词或私钥。任何要求你输入助记词、私钥或向个人地址转账的页面都是骗局。
guide.done_when: 已确认官方域名，并准备好专用的独立空投钱包。

guide.title: Visit the Tread fi Terminal
guide.description: Go to the Tread fi website and open the app to begin.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Sign In or Create an Account
guide.description: Register with your email address or by connecting a crypto wallet. Existing users should sign in with the same method used during Season 1 so their points and allocation carry over.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Connect Your Exchange Accounts
guide.description: Open the wallet section from the icon in the top right of the dashboard and link your trading venues: Connect your Hyperliquid account Optionally add Aster , Pacifica , Bybit, or an EVM wallet Trading to earn points requires real capital on your connected venues. If you need to fund an account, you can buy assets on Binance or using the below widget. Bridge funds Swap and bridge across 30+ chains
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Check Your Season 1 Points
guide.description: If you traded during Season 1, open the points dashboard to review your accrued points. These points feed into your retroactive TREAD allocation, which becomes claimable once the Foundation confirms the snapshot and opens distribution.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Trade to Earn Season 1.5 Points
guide.description: Route trades through the terminal to accumulate Season 1.5 points, distributed pro-rata by your adjusted trading volume across connected exchanges.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Generate Your Referral Link
guide.description: Create a referral link from the referral section to earn a share of the volume generated by traders you invite.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Track Distribution Announcements
guide.description: Watch the airdrop claims list and the official Tread channels so you know the moment eligibility and the TREAD claim go live.
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

guide.title: Set Up a Custom Agent
guide.description: Open the Agents section Configure settings and select which exchange you want the agent to trade on Go to New Agent Use an agent built by Tread or create your own
guide.done_when: 页面显示该步骤已完成 / 状态已更新。

faq.q: 积分一定会兑换 Token 吗？
faq.a: 不一定。积分与 Token 之间没有必然兑换关系，请勿将全部精力投入单一项目。
存在一定风险，新手请务必先阅读风险提示再决定。

任何要求输入助记词、私钥或恢复短语的页面都不可信。
